name: Egress monitor
summary: Live 'egress top': per-application outbound traffic (rate, destinations, cadence) through the trust/provenance lens, with an inferred exfiltration risk (capability x egress). Sudo-CLI observation (nettop + lsof), observe-only, reads no payloads.
targetWindow: v0.4.0-rc1 on the feat/egress-monitor branch; real destination names deferred to v0.4.1 (packet capture)
updateSource: SDD execution of the egress-monitor plan

required.title: internal/egress: parse -> rate -> aggregate -> concern/exfil
required.summary: nettop/lsof parsers, reset-safe out-rate diff + cadence, group-by-app aggregation (collapse pids/ports/protocols, worst-case trust), concern scoring and exfil inference (capability x egress). Pure given inputs; exec edge + joins injectable.

required.title: Live egress TUI + non-TTY report
required.summary: Tick-driven live 'egress top' (expand/collapse per app, concern color, sparkline, detail strip) keeping internal/tui -> internal/model only; non-TTY windowed report + --json; the `egress` subcommand wired into main (TTY -> TUI, else report).

required.title: 80% coverage rule + mockable integration + GitHub Actions CI
required.summary: Every package >=80% (overall 91%); exec edges (nettop/lsof/ps/codesign/TCC) and the terminal behind injectable seams so tests run in CI without sudo/tools; GitHub Actions workflow gates build/vet/gofmt/test at >=80% coverage. Rule recorded in rules.json.

deferred.title: Real destination names via packet capture
deferred.summary: SNI/DNS destination names + per-flow volume via pktap/tcpdump; v1 shows IP:port.
deferred.reason: Sequencing: the observe loop (nettop+lsof) establishes the per-app egress picture first; packet capture adds pcap parsing best layered on a working monitor. Recorded as roadmap v0.4.1.

outOfScope.title: Network Extension continuous filter
outOfScope.summary: A NEFilterDataProvider system extension needs an Apple entitlement + signed app + system-extension install — a different product that abandons the CLI architecture. Explicitly not this release.

workstreams.name: Egress monitor
workstreams.summary: Live per-app egress observation through the trust/provenance lens with inferred exfil risk. Built + coverage-hardened + CI-gated; pending final whole-branch review and tag.
